bio: 183 Wilboi is a DMV-area rap-rock artist (Hagerstown, Maryland) fusing rap rock and rock rap, built for the adrenaline media market — extreme sports, action gaming, trailers. CWI's Rock-Rap Revival identifies Black as co-producer on the core catalog, with priority tracks Stunt (2024) and Full Moon (2022; 24,293 plays). His album All Pretty Girls Love 8 is listed on Anghami (Aug 2025) with OMG, What She Talm Bout?, I Love The Way, and Beside Me (Dont Mind Me). The album Sorry For The Heartbreak is on WildLyfe Records, not CWI, and is excluded from the CWI catalog. Black's co-production on Stunt and Full Moon is owner-confirmed (2026-10-02).
